purpose: Repeat one safe control-plane iteration from a continuation-ready task without requiring a new manual message.

iteration.rule: Consume exactly one validated inactive task, require its inactive start handoff, record its execution and reconciliation, and queue exactly one validated next candidate.
iteration.selection: The next candidate must be selected from the supplied catalog by an exact task ID; missing, duplicate, current-task, or unsafe candidates fail closed.

identity: Every output preserves the ready task's campaign, version, canonical Controller identity, policy, source commit/tree, parent handoff, and parent reconciliation.
readback: Execution must be a completed inactive CONTROL_PLANE_RECORD_ONLY readback with complete JSON, no findings, only control-plane source paths, and all forbidden effects false.
persistence: Execution, reconciliation, and queued-task records are content-addressed, bounded to the control-plane root, compare-and-swap protected, written atomically, and read back as JSON.
stop_conditions: Any owner decision, campaign, version, policy, identity, parent, scope, source, or boundary mismatch.
Any campaign activation, Product write, Product-agent spawn, deployment, release, push, merge, sterile-copy, secret, or destructive request.
Any missing, ambiguous, stale, malformed, summarized-only, or unreadable record or check.
owner_feedback: Open user-visible roughness stays in docs/owner-feedback-backlog.md and may be scheduled only as bounded control-plane follow-up work.
undo: Remove the loop records and revert only the isolated development commit; leave the parent campaign evidence, approval, and inactive status unchanged.
